name: Saeta
verdict: Founded and owned by Pedro Aníbal Carrero: Saeta International Sports Wear S.A.S., the private Bogotá sportswear company that has made Haiti's kits since 2013. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: private Colombian sportswear maker founded in Bogotá in 1982 by Pedro Aníbal Carrero (legal name Saeta International Sports Wear S.A.S.; Carrero is 'fundador y propietario' per Infobae, 20 June 2026; Carrero family in strategic roles per Las2orillas, 19 June 2026). No state body or fund in the chain, and no court, regulator, UN body or major-NGO human-rights finding against Saeta found (searched 1 Oct 2026).
